item.name: JSON Web Key Set for admin JWT verification

request.description:
Public verification keys for admin-issued JWTs, keyed by `kid`. Two `kid`s
may be valid simultaneously during a rotation. Mobile clients pin and do
not consume JWKS; this endpoint is on the admin host only.

item.name: Step 2 — submit TOTP or recovery code, receive admin JWT

request.description:
*(v1.1, CRIT-09)* Accepts EITHER a 6-digit TOTP code OR a 10-hex-character
single-use recovery code. Exactly one of `totp` / `recovery_code` MUST be
present. Successful recovery-code use consumes that code.

item.name: Generate a fresh set of 8 single-use recovery codes (v1.1, CRIT-09)

header.description:
Optional. Same `(scope, actor, key)` returns the cached response for 24 h.
Same key + different body → `409 idempotency_mismatch`.

request.description:
Invalidates the previous set atomically and returns a new set of 8 codes ONCE.
Requires a fresh TOTP confirmation in the body (re-auth pattern). The plaintext
codes never leave this response.

request.description:
The current user PLUS everything the authed app needs on launch (no second/third request):
profile, registration_completed, email_verified, has_password, locale, timezone, app config +
feature flags, the user's installs, active subscriptions, unread-notifications count, permissions.
**The `data` object is intentionally extensible** — future sections (apartments, vehicles, devices,
complexes, notifications, invitations, visitor_passes, family_members, payments) are added as NEW
keys without changing the existing contract.

Everything a logged-out client needs to start safely in ONE request — maintenance mode,
min/latest version + force-update flag, public OTP settings, public app settings, feature flags
and support contacts. All values are admin-editable in Settings.

Register (first/last name, phone, email) and send an email OTP

request.description:
Creates an unverified account (or reuses an existing **unverified** one — re-registering the same
email does not duplicate). An already-verified email returns **409**; a phone already taken by a
verified account returns **422**. A 6-digit OTP is emailed (TTL/resend from Settings). No Device /
Resident / Subscription is created. Rate limit: 5/email/hour + 20/IP/hour.

item.name: Verify the email OTP → issue tokens (auto-login). Registration + login.

request.description:
Verifies the outstanding email OTP for the address (used by BOTH registration and email login).
On success, in **one transaction**: sets email_verified_at (first time), last_login_at/ip,
registers the install, and issues the refresh + 15-min RS256 access token. Rate limit:
10/email/10min.
Anti-enumeration — identical response whether or not the account exists. Rate limit 3/email/10min.

item.name: Request an email login OTP (returning, verified user)

request.description:
Sends a login OTP to a verified account; verification is completed via **/auth/verify-email**.
Anti-enumeration — identical response regardless of existence. Rate limit 5/email/10min + 30/IP/hour.
Forward-compatible: designed to also accept an optional `password` when the future Security feature
ships (no breaking change).
Super-admin only. Issues a new admin JWT whose claims carry `impersonator_admin_id`. Audited.

item.name: Browser redirect-back from the BirPay hosted checkout

request.description:
Public. The hosted checkout redirects the customer here after pay/cancel. Query params are **not trusted** —
the order is re-verified via `getOrderStatus` before any state change. Returns a small HTML/redirect.

header.description: Base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body.

request.description:
Inbound, **signature-authenticated** (no JWT). `X-Signature` = Base64(HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, sharedSecret))
with the secret from Settings (`payments.webhook_secret`). Invalid/duplicate signatures are rejected.
The webhook is treated as a *hint*: `getOrderStatus` is the authoritative source of truth. Idempotent.
Events: `payment_succeeded`, `payment_canceled`.

header.description: Shared secret negotiated with the Traccar instance.

request.description:
Inbound, **shared-secret token** authenticated (no JWT). Traccar forwards position/event payloads here;
the controller ingests device telemetry (online state, last position).
